page.overview:
Who is Michelangelo Splinterson?

Michelangelo is one of the main protagonists of the 2003 Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles TV series. His personality is more akin to the Mirage comics. Still the comic relief, he often makes statements that spoof pop culture (such as Star Wars, Star Trek, and Terminator), although he uses less surfer language than in the . His trademark nunchaku are once again his primary weapons, but he has used other weapons such as grappling hooks and those of his brothers.

Michelangelo is a mutant turtle with the same general appearance as , , and , although he has an orange bandana and orange wrappings on his weapons.

Michelangelo is an energetic, laidback, lively, and athletic turtle. He is the most carefree and mischievous of his brothers. Mikey tends to mock and tease enemies and even his family by coming up with rude but funny remarks. He would mock Splinter‘s phrases and accent, and make remarks towards his brothers. He also tends to pull classic pranks on his brothers, like putting hot sauce on Raph’s cereal, smoke bombs in the toilet, or putting glue on Don’s bō staff. He is also the wise-guy of the group as he would make remarks that are pop culture references.

He also has the most raw talent when it comes to his skillsets which causes him to be incredibly cocky. Mikey believes he shouldn't have to practice his ninjutsu skills as often as his brothers do and prefers to spend his time reading comics or watching tv. He also can be very cocky and doesn't take his accomplishments with humility. In the Season 2 finale "The Big Brawl", he became the Champion, the best fighter in the multiverse. However, when fighting in the Tournament, he only actually won one fight properly. Since that battle, Mikey rubs it in his brothers’ faces.
